title: Two slips at a payment counter

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: One payment generated two slips. The first says approved. The second printed when I pressed copy. Which one should I attach to our report?
turns.zh: 一筆付款印了兩張單據。第一張顯示核准，第二張是我按補印後印的。我該把哪張附在報表上？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Use either one if the transaction number matches. A new print time isn't a new charge. Check the payment list, not the printer log.
turns.zh: 交易號碼相同的話，附哪張都可以。列印時間不同不代表又扣一筆款。要查付款清單，不是印表機紀錄。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Both slips show the same number. But the list shows another payment for the same amount just before this one.
turns.zh: 兩張的交易號碼相同。不過清單上緊接這筆之前，還有一筆金額相同的款項。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Compare the order references. If that earlier payment belongs to another order, keep it separate.
turns.zh: 比對訂單編號。如果較早的款項屬於另一張訂單，就分開記錄。
